aboutGame.title: What is onthinicewiki?
paragraphs: On Thin Ice is an atmospheric detective mystery and logic puzzle adventure featuring Detective Kate Gray and Detective Murphy as they unravel a dangerous cyber syndicate. Cut off by a relentless winter blizzard, players explore sub-zero crime scenes, interrogate suspicious colleagues, and crack intricate security systems.

On Thin Ice Wiki (onthinicewiki) provides players with comprehensive chapter-by-chapter walkthroughs, verified keypad codes, detailed logic puzzle breakdowns, and forensic strategies to conquer every obstacle in the game.

items.question: What is onthinicewiki?
items.answer: On Thin Ice Wiki (onthinicewiki) is a comprehensive player resource and guide hub for the detective adventure game On Thin Ice by Haiku Games, featuring puzzle codes, chapter walkthroughs, and gameplay tips.

items.question: How do I solve puzzle codes on onthinicewiki?
items.answer: On Thin Ice Wiki (onthinicewiki) provides verified step-by-step solutions for all keypad combinations, including the Chapter 3 locker code and the hard drive decryption code.

items.question: How many chapters are covered on onthinicewiki?
items.answer: On Thin Ice Wiki (onthinicewiki) covers all four major story chapters of Detective Kate Gray's investigation, with complete scene-by-scene walkthroughs.

items.question: Does onthinicewiki provide solutions for the elevator puzzle?
items.answer: Yes, onthinicewiki (On Thin Ice Wiki) offers a complete breakdown for the Chapter 2 Lobby Bot conversation, wall safe dial, and elevator circuit board.

items.question: Is onthinicewiki free to use for all players?
items.answer: Yes, all walkthroughs, puzzle solutions, and strategy guides on On Thin Ice Wiki (onthinicewiki) are completely free to access.
